text:
Jordan T.: Heads-up — customer cust-204 opened a dispute: INV-7014 shows both duplicated burst and an incorrect proration after we moved their reserved commit between nodepools mid-cycle. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_7014.pdf :grimacing:
Maya L.: Oof. Which window and what lines look wrong?
Jordan T.: Billing window 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-30. Condensed CSV from repro: ```line_item_id,desc,nodepool,committed_units,used_units,burst_units,amount
H7001,Reserved commit (apac-core),apac-core,120000,110000,0,6000.00
H7002,Burst usage,apac-core,120000,25000,25000,1250.00
H7003,Reserved commit (apac-standby),apac-standby,60000,59000,0,3000.00
H7004,Burst usage,apac-standby,60000,25000,25000,1250.00
H7005,Proration adjustment - commit transfer,apac,120000,0,0,-900.00
``` The problem: the 25k burst looks billed on both pools (H7002 & H7004) after we migrated half the reserved commit on 2026-09-15. Also the proration line H7005 subtracts $900 but doesn't net against the duplicated bursts correctly, leaving customer overcharged approx $1,300.
Sam (Billing): Do we have an internal event for the commit transfer? vendor or internal migration?
billing-bot: Migration event recorded: commit-transfer ct-5512 on 2026-09-15T22:03:12Z. Source pool apac-core -> apac-standby. Metering notes: tags reissued without origin_tag preserved. Logs: /events/ct-5512.log
Maya L.: Looks like our commit-transfer flow re-registered the same requests under the new pool tag while the old pool still recorded the tail of traffic for ~7m. That would produce two billable streams for overlapping minutes. Runtime should have cleared the origin_tag once transfer completed but that didn't happen.
Jordan T.: Customer says they were throttled during the migration window and asked for SLA consideration as well. They want an immediate corrected invoice and explanation.
Sam (Billing): Policy: when duplication results from internal commit transfer/migration, billing credits duplicated burst and reconciles proration so net shows accurate committed allocation. Required artifacts: (1) commit-transfer event log, (2) token-hash dedupe showing identical token ids in overlapping windows, (3) mapping of both line items to cust-204, (4) proof of proration calculation from charge engine. If all satisfied, provide full duplicated-burst credit and apply correct proration adjustment; offer 5% goodwill credit on next invoice for disruption.
Evan (Finance): Finance pre-approves provisional correction up to $1,500 pending verification. JE code: 8-900-BILL, memo: "commit-transfer duplication cust-204". Final approval after vendor reconciliation and dedupe.
Jordan T.: I've uploaded initial artifacts to case BILL-2026-718: condensed CSV, ct-5512.log, and the customer's support transcript. Placing INV-7014 on hold until 2026-10-05.
infra-bot: Metering-proxy bug detected: when commit-transfer API called, origin_tag not preserved for fallback traffic. Filed INFRA-1001. Patch planned that adds persistent ingress_tag during transfer. ETA 9 days.
Maya L.: Devops to run token dedupe for 2026-09-15T21:50 -> 2026-09-15T22:15 window. Export path: /exports/cust-204/20260915_token_hashes.csv. ETA 4h.
Sam (Billing): Once dedupe confirms duplication, billing will (a) request vendor reclassification for H7004 if vendor-side metering created the duplicate, (b) adjust H7005 proration to offset duplicated bursts so net is correct, (c) issue a provisional credit and reissue invoice draft for customer review.
Evan (Finance): Please include predicted net credit in the case update after dedupe. Finance will book a provisional reserve against JE 8-900-BILL until finalization.
Jordan T.: Customer-facing note drafted: "We've placed INV-7014 under review. Pending token verification and vendor reconciliation, you'll receive a correction on the duplicated burst lines and a proration adjustment; we'll also offer a small goodwill credit for the inconvenience." I'll post when we have the dedupe.
Sam (Billing): Also flagging a secondary issue: tax code mapping for the proration line H7005 used an incorrect VAT rate (apac vs apac-eu mapping) — that could change the net amount by ~$45. Billing will check tax_class mapping and open VEND-TAX-88 with tax vendor.
Maya L.: Agreed — infra fix for origin_tag persistence and billing vendor fix for tax mapping both required. INFRA-1001 and VEND-TAX-88 noted in case BILL-2026-718.
billing-bot: Token dedupe job started. ETA 3h. Output to: /exports/cust-204/dedupe_report_20260915.json
Evan (Finance): Good. Keep Finance looped. If dedupe confirms, we can proceed with provisional JE and notify accounting.
Jordan T.: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket and the customer thread once the dedupe completes. :thumbsup:
